selected_corpus_limits.note: This is post-retrieval confirmation on a selected corpus. The five newly confirmed positives were drawn from the same selected retrieval candidate corpus, so these metrics are not independent held-out validation or corpus-wide estimates.
selected_corpus_limits.recall_scope: Known positive recall is relative to the seven confirmed positives other than each query image.
selected_corpus_limits.precision_scope: P@32 is a lower bound; unjudged results remain unknown and are not inferred from tags.

pre_confirmation_report_metrics.limitation: Recall uses known positives only; unjudged results do not establish true precision
